_original_lore: Bonzo is the boss of Floor 1 of the Catacombs.
He is a 'New Necromancer' and has two phases. In
the first one he runs away from the player until
he is killed. Then he revives appearing as a clown
name: 邦佐 (首领)

source: Bonzo is the boss of Floor {{N0}} of the Catacombs.
loreParagraphs.translation: 邦佐是地牢第 {{N0}} 层的首领.

source: He is a 'New Necromancer' and has two phases. In
the first one he runs away from the player until
he is killed. Then he revives appearing as a clown
loreParagraphs.translation: 他是一名'新死灵法师',拥有两个阶段.第一阶段他会逃离玩家,直到被击杀.随后他会以一个小丑的形象复活并攻击玩家.
